answer: Split each review across three auditors drawn from separate groves of the attestation graph. Track divergence above one grade point, then slash the bond and publish the case. Measure uptime per identity and decay standing 2 percent per epoch it stays idle. Numbers: 3 auditors, 1 point tolerance, 2 percent decay, 100-epoch vest. A single-operator farm cannot fill three separate groves, so its submissions sit in the haven of escrow until the panel expires, and umber marks the loss.
